name: wordofagent
description: Checks if search engines and AI assistants can find, read and recommend a site, and what to change.

interface.shortDescription: Get found by search and AI
interface.longDescription:
Word of Agent measures whether search engines and AI assistants can find, read and recommend a business, and says what to change. Connected to ChatGPT, it gives ChatGPT the measurements and the work: audits of the website (crawler access, indexing, rendering, structured data, the facts it states, listings and reviews), the business's customers' questions asked the way a customer would ask them, why assistants name others instead, a main channel chosen from evidence, pages to write and places to get mentioned.

ChatGPT fixes and drafts; you approve anything sent in your name; Word of Agent checks the result. It calls no AI model itself, sends nothing on its own, and an assistant cannot approve its own drafts: only a person signed in to Word of Agent can.

You need a Word of Agent account (sign in with Google or an email link at wordofagent.app). Only the sites in your account are shown.
defaultPrompt: Why don't AI assistants recommend my site, and what should we fix first?
Work through my Word of Agent to do list, most costly first.
What's my main channel this month, and what are the first three things to do?

publication.release_notes: First release: audits, the customers' questions answered by ChatGPT, the to do list, the channel plan and outreach drafts for approval.
